lines.speaker: A
lines.meaning: What vegetables do you want today?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Deme medio kilo de tomates y cebollas.
lines.say: DE-me ME-dyo KEE-lo de to-MA-tes ee se-BO-yas.
lines.meaning: Give me half a kilo of tomatoes and onions.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Los tomates están frescos. Cuarenta rupias el kilo.
lines.say: los to-MA-tes es-TAN FRES-kos. kwa-REN-ta ROO-pyas el KEE-lo.
lines.meaning: The tomatoes are fresh. Forty rupees a kilo.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Es un poco caro. Déjelo en treinta, por favor.
lines.say: es oon PO-ko KA-ro. DE-he-lo en TREYN-ta, por fa-VOR.
lines.meaning: That is a little expensive. Please make it thirty.

lines.speaker: A
lines.say: es-TA byen, YE-be-lo. KYE-re tam-BYEN see-LAN-tro?
lines.meaning: All right, take it. Do you want some coriander also?

lines.speaker: B
lines.meaning: Yes, a small bunch. Thank you.
